correctness.rationale: The launch law is q into shell 1 on halving and p2^(-(j+1)) into shell j on doubling, with return immediately at j=0. Conditional hitting probabilities solve ph_(j-1)+qh_(j+1)=h_j, h_0=0,h_m=1, giving (r^j-1)/(r^m-1) for r=p/q !=1 and j/m at p=1/2. The launch average qh_1+p Σ_{j=1}^{m-1}2^(-j-1)h_j+p2^(-m) yields the claimed rational quotient. Direct limits at r=1,2 and q=0 give H_m(1/2)=(1-2^(-m-1))/m, H_m(2/3)=(m+1)/(3(2^m-1)), H_m(1)=2^(-m). Separate expansions give mH_m→2a/(e^(2a)-1) when m(2p-1)→a and (3·2^m/m)H_m→(1-e^(-t))/t when m log(p/(2q))→t; removable zero arguments are treated continuously. An independently implemented rational hitting-system check passed 84 exact (p,m) combinations. Those checks corroborate but cannot prove the asymptotic statements. Time-to-return and stationary-law claims are excluded.
